newsitem.title: USA: Ashland sees Marathon deal closing end-'97.
newsitem.headline: Ashland sees Marathon deal closing end-'97.

text.p: Ashland Inc chief executive officer Paul Chellgren said the company's planned joint venture with USX-Marathon Group is expected to be finalized by the end of 1997.
The planned deal, which still requires a definitive agreement, is not expected to run into regulatory hurdles, he told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"We don't expect any difficulties because the business continues to be extraordinarily competitive," Chellgren said.
Chellgren declined to discuss potential cost savings or job cuts associated with the joint venture. He said more due diligence is needed to determine those figures.
Chellgren also said the two companies had been in talks about the alliance since last year.
